$comment: mold_v0-219: the one registry of the shell's optional capabilities, each an on/off flag in the app's profile (profile.json `features`, {"<id>": true|false}). Read by src/features.ts (the server's gates), scripts/gen-packs.mjs (the console's pages and sidebar, web/src/config/features.generated.ts), the factory (.claude/scripts/lib/features.py: the app spec's `features`, the brief's `features.<id> = true|false` lines in ## Profile, `factory.py spec check`) and the factory board (plugins/factory-board). A capability is ON only when something asks for it (`requested_by`: a pack's declaration, or `always` for a profile toggle) AND its flag is not false. `default`: the flag's value when neither `features` nor a `legacy` key says: true where the capability was on whenever a pack declared it before this registry (so turning the flags on changes no existing app), false where it was an opt-in profile toggle. `legacy`: the profile key that said it before (still read; it and `features` must agree). `requires`: flags that must be on with it (`requires_any`: one of them). `quiet_off` (mold_v0-243): while off, the flag is left out of the build's generated files, so an app that never turns it on builds exactly what it built before the flag existed. Never edit an id: apps' state names them.

flags.label: Workspace credentials
flags.requested_words: a pack declares credential fields (pack.json credentials)
flags.about: Each workspace keeps its own credentials for the packs' runs (write-only, sealed with the workspace's key): the console's Credentials page (Settings › Credentials), /api/credentials, its OAuth connections (/api/credential-connections) and GitHub App installation (/api/github-app).
flags.off: No Credentials page or sidebar entry, and /api/credentials, /api/credential-connections and /api/github-app answer not found. Refused while a job kind needs a credential that is not optional (nobody could give it).

flags.label: Company email
flags.requested_words: a pack declares the company's own email (pack.json email: sender.allow or intake)
flags.about: A workspace's own sender (SMTP, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace) and mailboxes read into a record area: Settings › Email, /api/email, the email intake job and its MCP tools, Health's Email Delivery tab.
flags.off: No Settings › Email page or sidebar entry, /api/email answers not found, no mailbox is polled, no intake tool is listed, and every email goes out through the app's default sender.

flags.label: Scheduled alerts
flags.requested_words: a record area declares due dates (record_areas[].due), or a workspace area declares clocks (record_areas[].clocks, with record_clocks on): their reminders and escalation steps
flags.about: The daily due-date notices and their emails, and the clocks' reminders and escalation steps (an in-app notice, an email, a reassignment or a raised value): the Notices page and /api/notices.
flags.off: No due-date notice or email is posted and no clock step runs (clocks still show each record's deadline and status when record_clocks is on); no Notices page or sidebar entry, and /api/notices answers not found.

flags.label: Record clocks
flags.requested_words: a workspace record area declares clocks (record_areas[].clocks)
flags.about: Each record's deadlines: the clock check job, the records' `clocks` and `due` fields, the clock columns and Overdue filter, the record page's history, the Due soon card (/api/records/due-soon) and the clock MCP tools.
flags.off: No clock is computed or kept, no clock column, filter or history shows, the Due soon card is empty and no clock tool is listed; a metric or tab that counts by a clock is refused at build.

flags.label: Data audit trail
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records: Billing's Access log tab, /api/audit/data, the read_audit_trail MCP tool, staff's /admin/access-log.
flags.off: Nothing is written, no route answers, no tab or page shows and no tool is listed.

flags.label: Platform audit trail
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Every API and MCP request and sign-in, and every staff action on an account: /admin/access-log, /api/audit/platform, the admin MCP's read_platform_trail.
flags.off: Nothing is written, no route answers, no page shows and no tool is listed.

flags.label: Chain and sign
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Signed checkpoints of the hash-chained audit trails (Ed25519 over Merkle roots): the ledger checkpoint job, /api/ledger/verify and /checkpoints, /.well-known/ledger-keys.json, the verify_audit_trail MCP tool and Settings › Signing. On, the app needs APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY, which the factory makes (mold.json profile_secrets, lib/ledger_key.py: provision.py <app> --generate-secret APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY; mold_v0-227).
flags.off: No checkpoint is signed, no route or well-known key answers and no tool is listed (the chain itself is always kept where entries are written).

flags.label: On-premises runners
flags.requested_words: a job kind declares private_network: true
flags.about: A workspace installs a runner inside its own network for the kinds that need it: /api/runners, /api/runner, the runners section of Credentials, staff's Runners tab.
flags.off: No runner route, page, tab or enrolment; every run is hosted.

flags.label: Developer surface
flags.requested_words: a pack declares developer_surface (in the app spec: kind embedded with a developer_surface block)
flags.about: The REST API at /v1, /openapi.json, scoped keys, client sessions, Standard Webhooks out and in, the SDKs, the developer console (Settings: API keys, Allowed origins, Webhooks, Integrations) and Health's Webhook Delivery tab. In the app spec `kind` stays the switch: kind embedded (with its developer_surface block) is what requests it; this flag only turns a declared surface off and must agree with kind.
flags.off: Nothing of it is mounted, no table is read, no event is queued and no page shows.

flags.label: Declarative checks
flags.requested_words: a pack declares checks (pack.json checks)
flags.about: Yes/no questions the records answer: /api/checks, /v1/checks, the check_<name> MCP tools, with their fallback rules (first_of) and percentage bucketing (bucket conditions; mold_v0-224/225/226), a client session's checks scopes and the onboarding's check tools.
flags.off: No check route answers and no check tool is listed.

flags.label: Encrypted fields
flags.requested_words: a record area's field declares encrypted: true
flags.about: Fields envelope-encrypted at rest, masked on every read, revealed on purpose: the reveal routes and MCP tools and the encrypted-field migration job.
flags.off: Refused at build while a pack declares an encrypted field (turning it off never stores a value in the clear); with none, nothing of it runs.

flags.label: Health history
flags.requested_words: a build without the session engine (no host pack owns products, scenarios, simulations and agent_sessions)
flags.about: Health › Status's graphs: a sample of the live checks every few minutes (health_samples), its scheduled job and GET /api/admin/onboarding/health/history.
flags.off: No sample is taken or kept and the job is not scheduled: Status keeps its live checks and headlines, and its graphs have no history (no sample in any bucket).

flags.label: Document previews
flags.requested_words: a record area's field of type file, or a field that previews its URL's document (preview: document)
flags.about: A record's documents as cards under its fields: GET /api/records/<area>/<key>/files (and staff's), each file's preview (PDF, images, text, sanitised HTML) or download, and the console's document cards.
flags.off: The file card routes answer not found and the console shows no document card; the files stay stored and the records keep their file fields.

flags.label: Workspace agent
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: A long-lived agent a person talks to, run through a harness in the workspace's own run sandbox: its sessions, steering mid-run (guidance, approvals, pause, resume, stop), parking and crash recovery, its budgets and retention. /api/agent, the agent MCP tools, the top bar's agent icon (the brand's own, or a workspace owner's in Settings › Workspace agent, mold_v0-252) and /app/agent (staff: /admin/agent and the Workspace agent settings).
flags.off: No route answers, no tool is listed, no icon, page, Settings tab or setting shows, and no agent session can start; the generated files leave its flag out.

flags.label: Record page layouts
flags.requested_words: a record area's page layout (detail), a field marked copyable, an area whose Key follows its Title, or a tab column computed from related records
flags.about: A record's page laid out as its area declares (detail): a header with the title, a summary, coloured status badges, who added it and up to 8 facts; notices shown while a condition on the record holds; tabs of sections, each a card of field groups in 1, 2 or 3 columns with its own empty state; and copy buttons for the record's id, the page's link and each copyable field. Part 2 (mold_v0-254): sections listing another area's records that point back here (their columns, sort, limit, Show all, each row's own actions) or the runs that ran on the record; the header's actions (a primary, secondaries, a More menu: start a run on the record, move it, edit, delete, open a linked record, copy the link), each offered to and enforced for the roles that may, through /api/records/_page. mold_v0-254: related lists, a record's runs and the header's actions. mold_v0-256: a run's own page (/app/runs/<id>), the event/log viewer, a record's change history, code, table and file sections, facts and list columns computed from related records, Add <related record> with its fields filled in, a record picker for reference fields and a Key from the Title.
flags.off: Every record page is the one details card it always was (every field, then documents, deadlines, links and credentials); /api/records/_page answers nothing; the layouts stay declared and checked, and the generated files leave them and the flag out.

flags.label: Forms in a side panel
flags.requested_words: always (the profile alone)
flags.about: Add and edit forms of records (an area's Add, a record's Edit, a staff record's New and Edit, a record page's Add <related record>) open first in a panel at the right of the list or the page, which stays in view: Open full page expands the same form, its typed values kept, to the full in-page card. Focus stays in the panel, Esc closes it, and closing it with unsaved changes asks first. On a phone (640 px or narrower) the panel fills the screen.
flags.off: Every form is the full in-page card it always was; the generated files leave the flag out.

flags.label: Teams and record visibility
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it; a record area's visibility, record_areas[].visibility, takes effect only with it on)
flags.about: Teams inside a workspace, each with a name, members and leads, managed by the workspace's owners in Settings › Teams (each team's page lists its people, records and changes; every membership change is kept). A record area that declares visibility gives each record its own: open to the workspace, shared with one team, or private to its owner, with named collaborators where the area allows them. The database enforces it on every read and write (lists, record pages, related lists, computed facts and columns, the record picker, exports, metrics and charts, the MCP tools, the workspace agent's tools, the data and developer APIs): a person sees a record that is open to the workspace, theirs, one they collaborate on, or their team's; the workspace's owners see every record. Create and edit forms get a visibility field, lists a Visibility column and filter, record pages a Visibility line and Share.
flags.off: No Teams tab, no /api/teams, no visibility field, column, filter or Share; every record is open to its whole workspace, as before, and the generated files leave the flag out.

flags.label: Run inputs from a record
flags.requested_words: a job kind takes arguments from the record it runs on (job_kinds[].input_from_record)
flags.about: A run started on a record takes its arguments from that record's fields (input_from_record: argument -> field, $key or $title): a record page's start_run action fills them on the server, and the kind's start tool takes record {area, key}, read as the caller in the caller's workspace; the run carries the record (runs.record_area, record_key).
flags.off: The start tools take no record and a record page's action sends only what its own input maps, as before; the declarations stay checked.

flags.label: Private catalogs
flags.requested_words: an upstream catalog read with a deploy key or the platform's GitHub App (repositories.<name>.access)
flags.about: A shared catalog indexed from a private repository, pinned to its commit as before: over git and SSH with a deploy key, or over HTTPS with a token of the platform's own GitHub App installation. Staff set the key (and its host's public key) or the installation in Admin › Key vault, Private catalogs; never in a pack.
flags.off: A private catalog is not fetched (its index is refused, saying the flag is off), and Admin › Key vault has no Private catalogs card; the generated files leave the flag out.

flags.label: Wide lists
flags.requested_words: an area's list_columns or a tab's columns past 8
flags.about: A list of up to 12 columns: its table scrolls sideways inside its card only (the page never does) with the first column kept in view.
flags.off: A list has at most 8 columns: more is refused at build; every table is as before.

flags.label: Record rules
flags.requested_words: a reference field limited by a condition on its target (where), or an area's checks on save (on_save)
flags.about: A reference field's where: the record picker lists only the target's records it keeps, and every write refuses one it does not. An area's on_save: declarative checks (mold_v0-196) run on each create or change with inputs from the record, refusing with their message.
flags.off: Refused at build while a pack declares either (an unchecked rule would let records through that the pack says may not be saved).

flags.label: Credential sets and tenants
flags.requested_words: a credential with several labelled values (entries), or bound to a record of a tenant area (bound_to: tenant)
flags.about: A credential holding several labelled values (a list of hosts, each with its token), each sealed on its own and delivered to a run as one JSON object; and a tenant scope beside workspace, asset and environment: a credential bound to a record of the build's tenant area, set on that record's page and delivered to a run that targets it.
flags.off: Refused at build while a pack declares either (no value of them could be set or delivered).

flags.label: Overview cards
flags.requested_words: a home tab naming a fifth headline number, or the recent_runs or attention card in its rail
flags.about: The home page's headline row takes a fifth number; its rail takes a Recent runs card (the workspace's latest runs, as the person may read them) and a Needs attention card (the records whose page notices of tone warning or danger hold, from each area's detail.notices): GET /api/home/recent-runs and /api/home/attention.
flags.off: The home page is as before: a fifth headline number, a third rail card and the two cards are refused at build, as they always were; the routes answer not found; the generated files leave the flag out.

flags.label: Run analytics
flags.requested_words: always (the profile alone)
flags.about: Runs broken down by record, person, model, tool and failure reason, with tokens by model, from the runs' spend and their events: a workspace's own at /app/run-analytics (GET /api/analytics/runs, its billing managers and owners) and staff's across the workspaces at /admin/run-analytics (GET /api/admin/onboarding/run-analytics).
flags.off: No page, sidebar entry or route; the generated files leave the flag out.

flags.label: Filters in the address
flags.requested_words: always (the profile alone)
flags.about: The dashboards' filters are kept in the page's address (staff's Overview: its period and search; a workspace's Activity: its period; run analytics: period, kind, status and workspace), so a link reproduces the view and Back steps through the filters.
flags.off: The filters live in the page only, as before: a link opens the default view.

flags.label: Usage over MCP
flags.requested_words: always (the profile alone)
flags.about: The customer MCP's get_usage tool: spend, runs and tokens for a period, of the caller's own workspace (billing managers and owners: the whole workspace; anyone else: their own runs).
flags.off: No get_usage tool is listed (the customer MCP's surface is as before).

flags.label: Workspace recipes
flags.requested_words: the staff Records group lists the recipes page (console.admin_records in a pack.json or the app's profile.json)
flags.about: Reusable agent workspace recipes: named, versioned bundles of files and runtime binaries that staff upload at /admin/recipes (/api/admin/onboarding/recipes), which an agent profile's workspace picks instead of files of its own; the agent of a session may propose an updated version of the recipe it used, an approval request that staff accept as a new version or decline.
flags.off: No page, sidebar entry or route; an agent profile names no recipe and a session receives none; the generated files leave the flag out.
